findings.summary: Freeze state and ceiling record are not published atomically, allowing a resume gap to leave a ceiling for a runnable task.
SpawnReplacement trusts a stale ceiling record without validating old_tid still exists and is frozen; general exit paths do not clear the record.
SpawnReplacement bypasses the exact supervisor launch-edge authorization used by ordinary SpawnFromPath.
Supervisor hotswap hard-freezes before Snapshot, so state transfer cannot run and E2E hotswap remains unproven.
